aboutMe.title: About Me
aboutMe.paragraph1: I am José Guillermo Vargas Rodríguez, a Technologist in Analysis and Development of Information Systems (ADSI) and a Systems Engineer in training, passionate about creating software solutions that combine performance, scalability, and an excellent user experience.
aboutMe.paragraph2: Over the past two plus years, I have participated in the development of enterprise web applications for public entities and private companies, collaborating across all stages of software development: from requirements analysis and architectural design to implementation, documentation, and deployment of solutions in production.
aboutMe.paragraph3: I specialize in Full Stack development, using technologies such as Angular, React, Node.js, Express.js, and Go (Golang) to build modern applications, REST APIs, and scalable platforms. I also have experience working with PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB, optimizing databases and designing efficient data models.
aboutMe.paragraph4: Throughout my journey, I have worked with Microservices, Microfrontends, Monorepo, and Multitenancy architectures, as well as implementing Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines using GitHub Actions and Drone to automate delivery and enhance software quality.
aboutMe.paragraph5: I enjoy solving complex problems through simple and maintainable solutions. I always strive to write clean code, learn new technologies, and take part in projects that present technical challenges and deliver a real impact for organizations and their users.
